events.name: Bash
events.head: Find env vars the backend requires at boot
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; grep -rhoE "[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{4,} (must be set|is required|is not set|not configured)" src | grep -v spec | sort -u | head -30

events.text: The preview image builds and starts, but the backend stops at boot when env vars are missing. I'm adding throwaway local placeholder values and retrying.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Retry backend with placeholder env until health answers
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; f=/tmp/t154-preview.env; for v in UNSUBSCRIBE_HMAC_SECRET TRACKING_HMAC_SECRET; do echo "$v=$(openssl rand -hex 32)" >> $f; done; echo "REDIS_[redacted]" >> $f

events.name: Bash
events.head: Add placeholders and retry health with crash detection
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; f=/tmp/t154-preview.env; cat >> $f <<'EOF'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find remaining required env vars
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; grep -rhoE "[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{4,} (environment variable is required|env var is required|must be (set|configured|defined))" src | grep -v spec | sort -u | head; grep -rhoE "process\.env\.[A-Z0-9_]+ *(\|\||\?\?)? *\)?;? *\n?" src >/dev/null; grep -rhoE "throw new Error\([\`'\"][A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{4,}[^\`'\"]{0,40}" src | grep -v spec | sort -u | head -20

events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; f=/tmp/t154-preview.env; echo "ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)" >> $f; echo "SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ENC_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)" >> $f
